title: Wargames Ending
summary: The final scene of the 1983 film WarGames, in which the WOPR computer runs through nuclear war scenarios and concludes that the only winning move is not to play. It is a six-minute clip uploaded in higher quality than earlier copies.
why: HN cites it as shorthand for the tic-tac-toe lesson, especially in threads about AI and nuclear strategy or games that cannot be won.

quote.text: Make LLM's win every game of tic-tac-toe and see if it reaches the same conclusion of WOPR.
